HOME SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Overview of Home Science? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Overview of Home Science.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Overview of Home Science.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Overview of Home Science.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Overview of Home Science.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Hygiene and Safety.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Hygiene and Safety.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food Hygiene and Safety.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety in the Home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety in the Home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety in the Home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety in the Home.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety in the Home.

14. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene ? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods 1.5 Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene .

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Cooking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Housing the Family and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
